title: Request a human support agent
aliases: Transfer the call to a human agent
I want to talk to a human
I want to speak to someone
Can I speak with a person
Let me speak to an agent
I don't want to talk to the bot
Kindly connect me to your executive
Please put me through to a person
overview: A customer can request a human support agent without first completing account verification. This is a normal support request, not a security incident. The support agent receives the existing issue and conversation context, so the caller does not need to repeat the request to the assistant.
procedure: Prepare a support handoff with the previous issue, masked conversation, authentication status and customer request. Place it in the support queue; only attempt telephone transfer when an approved agent destination is configured.
